transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in today?

I used to be able to focus for hours on designs, but now my mind feels foggy and I can’t make even basic decisions at work. I'm an engineering technician, and lately, it just feels like I can't think straight anymore.
In the past two weeks, have you also been feeling down, losing interest or pleasure in things, or having changes in sleep, appetite, or energy?

Yes, I've completely lost interest in running and 3-D printing; those things just feel flat and pointless now. My energy is so low that my body feels like it's moving through molasses, and I can't sleep because I lie awake for hours replaying my mistakes at work. I just feel incredibly down and exhausted all the time.
Have you had any thoughts that life is not worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

On the really bad nights, I catch myself wishing I just wouldn't wake up the next morning. I've even found myself picturing what it would be like to drive my car off the overpass on my commute. I haven't actually acted on any of it, but the thoughts are definitely there.
Have you had any thoughts of actually acting on those ideas, or made any plan to hurt yourself?
No, I haven't made any actual plans or tried to do anything. The thoughts of driving off the overpass are really scary when they happen, but I've never acted on them.
Have you ever tried to hurt yourself before, or do you feel you might act on these thoughts soon?

No, I have never tried to hurt myself in the past, and I don't think I would act on these thoughts now. Even though I picture the overpass in detail on those bad nights, I don't actually want to do it, but having those thoughts is really scary.
Have you been hearing voices, seeing things other people don’t, or feeling strongly convinced that others are trying to harm you or that you have special powers or messages?

When I'm working late, I sometimes hear a calm voice in my head telling me I ruined the project and deserve punishment, and I'm convinced my boss and the client are secretly building a case to hold me personally responsible for my CAD errors. I don't have any special powers, and these voices and paranoid thoughts only happen when I'm feeling this deeply depressed.

When you hear that voice or feel that your boss and client are against you, do you ever believe those experiences are definitely real even when you’re not depressed, or do they only happen during the worst depressive episodes?

They definitely only happen when I am in this heavy, depressed state. On the rare days when my mood and energy feel closer to normal, those scary thoughts and the voice pretty much disappear completely.

The psychotic features are mood-congruent and disappear when mood improves, supporting F32.3 over F32.2.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient has a current major depressive episode with clear severe depressive symptoms (marked anhedonia, low energy, insomnia, psychomotor slowing/foggy thinking, impaired concentration/decision-making, hopelessness/worthlessness, and suicidal ideation). Psychotic symptoms are present during the depressive episode, including mood-congruent auditory hallucination-like experiences and persecutory delusional beliefs, and they resolve when mood improves. This supports severe depressive episode with psychotic symptoms (F32.3) rather than nonpsychotic severe depression.
